description: Joins two take logs for the same film into one, for when two phones, an AI assistant and a script supervisor each kept a log while offline. Joining is by op_id, so a take that is in both logs counts once and merging again changes nothing. Where two logs hold different takes under one op_id, only one is kept and the clash is counted, with a fix: give one of them an op_id of its own. The tools take text only, never video or audio, and no AI model runs. Input: a and b, two dpl.takes/1 objects. Output: {takes, merge}: takes is the joined dpl.takes/1 log; merge has added, already_present and conflicts: the counts of entries new to the joined log, entries that were in both, and entries that clashed (a count can be null if the engine did not send it). When conflicts is above 0, merge.conflict_fix says what to do: look before you trust the joined log. We don't keep either take log. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. Free, and it does not count toward the account's 3 free projects a month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

b.description: The second take log (dpl.takes/1), for the same work_id.

name: shoot_plan_merge_takes
